tools.name: search_memes
tools.description: Search memecub: Chinese 表情包 / 斗图 and English reaction memes and meme templates collected from the web (commercial_use=false), plus openly licensed emoji, art and photos (commercial_use=true). Search for the reaction you want in 1-3 words; Chinese queries find Chinese 表情包, English queries find Englis

tools.name: get_meme
tools.description: Full details for one image by id: license, source, author, credit line, tags.

tools.name: match_article
tools.description: Reads an article and returns where reaction images fit best, with a chosen image and alternatives for each spot, plus the article with images inserted as Markdown. Requires an API key and costs 10 credits. If you can read the article yourself, calling search_memes per spot (1 credit each) is cheaper

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "match_article" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Reads an article and returns where reaction images fit best, with a chosen image and alternatives for each spot, plus the article with images inserted as Markdown.
